title: In the Supermarket
sourceNote: Transcript is partly auto-captioned; the section names and some quantities were reconstructed. The ending is cut off.
objectives: I can name things and people in a supermarket
I can say what I want to buy with containers and quantities
I can ask where to find a product (Wo finde ich ...?)
I can pay at the checkout politely

I am coming from the supermarket.

grammar.title: zu, in, von: Dativ prepositions
grammar.body:
The prepositions **zu**, **in** (when asking *wo*), and **von** take the Dativ. With *der Supermarkt* the article becomes **dem**, which is shortened:

**zu + dem = zum**, **in + dem = im**, **von + dem = vom**.

examples.en: I am going to the supermarket.
I am coming from the supermarket.

grammar.title: Containers and quantities
grammar.body: After a container or measure word the product follows **directly**, with no *von* and no plural ending: *eine Dose Cola*, *ein Kilo Tomaten*, *ein Glas Honig*. The container word takes the **Akkusativ** article (*einen Becher*, *eine Packung*, *ein Stück*).

examples.de: Ich möchte ein Stück Käse kaufen.
examples.en: I would like to buy a piece of cheese.
I am buying a pack of detergent.

examples.en: I would like to buy a tub of yoghurt and a bar of chocolate.
I am buying a bottle of oil.

examples.en: I would like to buy a carton of milk.

examples.de: Ich möchte einen Beutel Reis kaufen.
examples.en: I would like to buy a bag of rice.

grammar.title: Measures: Kilo and Liter
grammar.body: Products that are not packaged are bought by weight or volume: **Kilo**, **Liter**. After numbers these words usually stay in the singular form: *zwei Kilo*, *zwei Liter*. Useful amounts: *ein halbes Kilo* (500 g), *anderthalb Kilo* (1.5 kg), *250 Gramm*; *ein Liter*, *ein halber Liter* (500 ml), *anderthalb Liter*, *250 Milliliter*.

examples.en: I am buying a kilo of tomatoes.

examples.de: Ich möchte ein halbes Kilo Äpfel kaufen.
examples.en: I would like to buy half a kilo of apples.
I am buying a litre of milk.

grammar.title: Where do I find ...?
grammar.body: Ask: *Entschuldigen Sie, wo finde ich hier ...?* The answer uses **bei** + Dativ with the name of the section: **beim** (bei + dem), **bei der**, **bei den**.
grammar.ar: الجواب يستخدم bei + حالة Dativ: beim / bei der / bei den.

mistakes.wrong: Ich kaufe ein Kilo von Tomaten.
Chips finden Sie bei dem Knabberzeug.

lines.de: Entschuldigen Sie, wo finde ich hier Chips?
lines.en: Excuse me, where do I find chips here?
You find chips in the snack section.

tip: Learn the section names together with bei: 'beim Knabberzeug', 'bei der Fleischtheke'. When you shop in Germany, look up at the signs above the shelves.

summary: zu, in, von + dem become zum, im, vom: zum Supermarkt, im Supermarkt, vom Supermarkt.
Containers (Dose, Packung, Flasche, Glas, Becher, Tafel, Beutel, Stück) are followed directly by the product.
For loose goods use Kilo and Liter: ein Kilo Tomaten, einen Liter Milch.
Ask Wo finde ich hier ...? and expect answers with beim / bei der / bei den.
At the checkout: Das macht ... Euro, bitte.
